title: AI Just Killed Stack Overflow: Traffic Down 99.4%
description:
AI is quietly killing the sites we all grew up googling 😅 Stack Overflow, the go to place for coders, lost almost all its organic google traffic. It fell from 207k questions a day to just 1,226, thats a 99.4% drop. And the crash lines up exactly with ChatGPT launch. When a model answers faster, the whole Q&A format just loses its point 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
